question: Which Conservative investors have a liquidity score below 25 and an allocation above 0% in the Banking sector?

question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow, total rebalance amount, total sector investment and risk score. Over investors that have all 4 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1, and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 rb.r_amt AS rebalance_amount,
                 al.a_inv AS sector_investment,
                 h.risk_score AS risk_score
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND rb.r_amt IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL AND h.risk_score IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(rebalance_amount) mn_1, MAX(rebalance_amount) mx_1, MIN(sector_investment) mn_2, MAX(sector_investment) mx_2, MIN(risk_score) mn_3, MAX(risk_score) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (rebalance_amount-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (sector_investment-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (risk_score-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.rebalance_amount,2) AS rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(per.sector_investment,2) AS sector_investment,
       ROUND(per.risk_score,2) AS risk_score
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

sql_query: WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, ROUND(c.net,2) AS net_cash_flow FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash c ON c.investor_id=p.investor_id WHERE p.risk_tolerance='Aggressive' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 g WHERE g.investor_id=p.investor_id AND g.shortfall > 0) ORDER BY net_cash_flow DESC, p.investor_id ASC LIMIT 10;
